description: This file is a code-behind partial class for the StartExam.aspx page in an online examination system. It manages user session validation, populates course dropdown based on semester, and handles start exam logic for theory and MCQ exams, including database interactions for exam availability and user exam status.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Partial class for managing exam start processes, user session validation, course selection, and exam initiation logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; validates session, fetches user semester info, and populates course dropdown based on the semester.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the user profile page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Empty event handler placeholder for selection button.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Starts the selected exam (theory or MCQ) by checking availability and setting session variables.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handler for semester dropdown change, currently empty.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handler for course dropdown change, currently empty.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of theory exams, checks if already attempted, and initializes exam session.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of MCQ exams, checks if already attempted, and initializes exam session.
